other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Haryana
Applicant must be a final‑year student in a UG or PG course in a government college
Applicant must not already possess a passport
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of passport application fee of ₹1,500/- provided through the student's college.
documents_required: Original documents submitted with the passport application
Self‑attested copies of the original documents
Copy of the online payment receipt (or SMS receipt)
Copy of the passport for fee reimbursement
